Transcription with verbose JSON response format including timestamp segments

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"file\":\"audio.mp3\",\"model\":\"whisper-1\",\"response_format\":\"verbose_json\"}", CreateTranscriptionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.transcribe(request)
    println(result.text)
    println(result.segments)
    println(result.segments?.first()?.id)
}
```
